units.source_text: 右近和侍从两人谈话。

en.t: Ukon and Jiju were talking together.

units.source_text: 右近说：“我有一个姐姐，在常陆国时和两个男子相好。

en.t: Ukon said, "I had an elder sister who, when she was in Hitachi Province, was involved with two men.

units.source_text: 人世间不管身份高下，这种事情总是有的。

en.t: In this world, such things happen no matter whether people are highborn or lowborn.

units.source_text: 这两个男子对我姐姐一样情深，不分优劣。

en.t: Both of those men loved my sister equally deeply, and neither could be called better than the other.

units.source_text: 我姐姐无所适从，弄得心迷意乱。

en.t: My sister did not know what to do and became utterly confused.

units.source_text: 有一次她对后相好的一个略微多表示了一点好感，

en.t: Once she showed just a little more favor to the man she had come to know later,

units.source_text: 那先相好的一个就嫉妒起来，终于把后一个杀死，

en.t: and the man who had known her first grew jealous and finally killed the other one,

units.source_text: 他自己也不再和我姐姐往来了。

en.t: and he himself stopped visiting my sister as well.

units.source_text: 可惜的是国守府里损失了一个能干的武士。

en.t: It was a pity that the provincial governor's household lost a capable warrior.

units.source_text: 而那个凶手呢，虽然也是国守府里优秀的家臣，

en.t: As for the killer, although he too was an excellent retainer in the governor's household,

units.source_text: 但是犯了这种过失，怎么还能任用呢？

en.t: after committing such an offense, how could he possibly still be employed?

units.source_text: 就被驱逐出境。

en.t: So he was banished from the province.

units.source_text: 这都是女人糊涂之故，因此我姐姐也不能留在国守府内，

en.t: All this came from a woman's foolishness, and so my sister could no longer remain in the governor's household,

units.source_text: 只得出去当了东国的民妇。

en.t: and had no choice but to leave and become a common woman in the eastern provinces.

units.source_text: 直到现在，我母亲想起了她还要哭泣呢。

en.t: Even now, my mother still weeps whenever she thinks of her.

units.source_text: 这真是罪孽深重的事啊！

en.t: It was truly a deeply sinful affair.

units.source_text: 我讲这话虽然似乎不祥，但无论身份高下，在这种事情上糊里糊涂，实在是很不好的。

en.t: It may sound ominous for me to say this, but no matter one's rank, it is truly wrong to be confused in such matters.

units.source_text: 即使不致丧失性命，也按各人身份而各有其痛苦。

en.t: Even if it does not cost someone their life, each person suffers according to their station.

units.source_text: 而身份高贵的人，有时反会受到比丧失性命更痛苦的耻辱呢！

en.t: And people of high rank may sometimes suffer disgrace more painful than losing their lives.

units.source_text: 所以我家小姐总须确定一方面才好。

en.t: That is why our young lady really ought to settle on one side.

units.source_text: 匂亲王比薰大将情深，只要是诚意的，小姐不妨追随他，

en.t: Prince Niou loves her more deeply than General Kaoru, and if his feelings are sincere, there would be no harm in her following him,

units.source_text: 不必如此忧愁苦闷了。

en.t: instead of grieving and suffering like this.

units.source_text: 影响了身体也是无补于事的。

en.t: Damaging her health will not help anything.

units.source_text: 夫人如此深切地关怀小姐，

en.t: The lady is so deeply concerned for our young mistress,

units.source_text: 我母亲又专心一意地准备迁居，妄想薰大将来迎接。

en.t: and my mother is single-mindedly preparing for the move, imagining that General Kaoru will come to fetch her.

units.source_text: 岂知匂亲王比他先下手。

en.t: But who would have thought Prince Niou would act before him?

units.source_text: 真是糟糕透顶！”

en.t: It is absolutely dreadful!"

units.source_text: 侍从说：“哎呀，不要说这种可怕的话了！

en.t: Jiju said, "Oh, please do not say such frightening things.

units.source_text: 万事都是宿命注定的。

en.t: Everything is determined by fate.

units.source_text: 只要是小姐心中稍稍倾慕的人，便是前世有缘的。

en.t: Anyone toward whom our young lady's heart inclines even slightly must have a bond with her from a previous life.

units.source_text: 实在，匂亲王那诚恳热烈的模样，叫人看了甚不敢当。

en.t: Truly, Prince Niou's earnest and passionate manner is almost overwhelming to behold.

units.source_text: 薰大将虽然如此急欲迎娶，小姐不会倾向他吧。

en.t: Although General Kaoru is so eager to take her as his bride, I do not think our young lady will turn toward him.

units.source_text: 据我想来，还不如暂时躲避薰大将，追随了那多情的匂亲王。”

en.t: To my mind, it would be better for her to avoid General Kaoru for a while and follow that tender-hearted Prince Niou."

units.source_text: 她是热诚赞美匂亲王的，此时信口直言。

en.t: She warmly admired Prince Niou, and at that moment she spoke frankly without restraint.

units.source_text: 但右近说：“据我看来，还是到初濑或石山去求求观世音菩萨：

en.t: But Ukon said, "As I see it, we should go to Hatsuse or Ishiyama and pray to the Bodhisattva Kannon:

units.source_text: 无论追随哪一方，总要保佑我们太平无事。

en.t: whichever side she follows, may we be protected and kept safe.

units.source_text: 薰大将这儿领地内各庄院的办事人，都是粗蛮的武夫。

en.t: The stewards of the estates on General Kaoru's lands here are all rough warriors.

units.source_text: 宇治地方到处都是他们一族的人。

en.t: The Uji area is full of members of their clan.

units.source_text: 凡在这山城国和大和国境内，

en.t: Throughout the provinces of Yamashiro and Yamato,

units.source_text: 大将领地各处庄院里的人，都是这里的那个内舍人的亲戚。

en.t: the people on the General's estates are all relatives of that guardsman here.

units.source_text: 大将任命他的女婿右近大夫当总管，吩咐他办理一切事情。

en.t: The General appointed his son-in-law, Ukon no Daibu, as overseer and ordered him to handle everything.

units.source_text: 身份高贵的人不会做出粗鲁的事情来。

en.t: A person of noble rank would not do anything crude.

units.source_text: 然而不明事理的田舍人，经常轮流地在这里守夜。

en.t: But ignorant country folk often take turns keeping night watch here.

units.source_text: 尽管希望在当值期间一点乱子也不出，然而难免发生意外的祸事。

en.t: Even though we hope nothing will go wrong while they are on duty, unexpected disasters are hard to avoid.

units.source_text: 像那天夜间小舟渡河之事，叫人想起了不寒而栗！

en.t: Just thinking of that night when the small boat crossed the river makes one shudder.

units.source_text: 亲王异常小心谨慎，随从也不带一个，衣服总是穿得很简朴。

en.t: The Prince is extraordinarily cautious, bringing not a single attendant and always dressing very plainly.

units.source_text: 如果被这些人看见了，真乃不堪设想啊！”

en.t: If these people were to see him, it would truly be unthinkable!"

units.source_text: 浮舟听了她们这些话，想道：“归根到底，是由于我的心倾向了匂亲王，所以她们说这些话。

en.t: Ukifune heard what they were saying and thought, "In the end, they are saying these things because my heart has turned toward Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 我真可耻！

en.t: How shameful I am!

units.source_text: 其实在我心中，对双方都不思慕。

en.t: In truth, in my heart I do not long for either of them.

units.source_text: 只是看到匂亲王焦灼万状，不知道他为何如此想我，

en.t: It is only that when I saw Prince Niou so desperately agitated, not knowing why he cared for me so much,

units.source_text: 因而像做梦一般吃惊，不免对他稍稍注意。

en.t: I was startled as if in a dream and could not help paying him a little attention.

units.source_text: 然而对于久蒙照拂的薰大将，我决不想突然离开他。

en.t: Yet I certainly do not want to leave General Kaoru suddenly, after he has cared for me for so long.

units.source_text: 为此弄得如此心绪缭乱。

en.t: That is why my heart has become so tangled and confused.

units.source_text: 诚如右近所说，闯出祸事来怎么办呢？”

en.t: As Ukon says, what will I do if some disaster comes of this?"

units.source_text: 她左思右想了一会，说道：“我真想死了！

en.t: After brooding over it for a while, she said, "I truly want to die.

units.source_text: 世间没有像我这样命苦的人！

en.t: There is no one in the world as unfortunate as I am.

units.source_text: 如此不幸之身，在下等人中也是少有其例的吧！”

en.t: Even among people of low station, there can hardly be anyone with such an unhappy fate!"

units.source_text: 说罢便把身子俯伏着。

en.t: Having said this, she bent forward and lay face down.

units.source_text: 这两个深知内情的侍女都说：“小姐不可如此伤心！

en.t: The two ladies-in-waiting who knew the situation well both said, "My lady, you must not grieve so much.

units.source_text: 我们是为了要使你安心，所以说这些话的。

en.t: We said these things only because we wanted to put your mind at ease.

units.source_text: 从前，你即使有了可忧之事，也满不在乎，泰然自若。

en.t: In the past, even when you had things to worry about, you paid them little mind and stayed calm.

units.source_text: 自从亲王之事发生以后，你一直忧伤烦恼，我们看了非常担心呢。”

en.t: Ever since the matter with the Prince began, you have been grieving and troubled, and it worries us deeply to see it."

units.source_text: 她们都心烦意乱，忙着商量办法。

en.t: They were all upset and busily discussed what could be done.

units.source_text: 那乳母只管兴致勃勃地染衣料，缝服装，准备迁居。

en.t: The nurse, meanwhile, cheerfully went on dyeing cloth, sewing garments, and preparing for the move.

units.source_text: 她把新来的几个美貌的女童唤到浮舟面前，对她说道：“小姐看看这些孩子，散散心吧。

en.t: She called several newly arrived, pretty young girls before Ukifune and said to her, "My lady, look at these children and cheer yourself a little.

units.source_text: 只管躺在那里发愁，恐怕是有鬼魂作祟呢。”

en.t: If you simply lie there worrying, I fear some spirit may be troubling you."

units.source_text: 说罢叹息一声。

en.t: After saying this, she gave a sigh.
